statements.t: They are generally identifiable by use of the words “may,” “will,” “should,” “anticipate,” “estimate,” “plans,” “potential,” “projects,” “continuing,” “ongoing,” “expects,” “management believes,” “we believe,” “we intend” or the negative of these words or other variations on these words or comparable terminology.
The Company is continuing to execute on a plan to achieve revenue growth.
The Company anticipates limited investing activities during the next twelve months.
The accompanying unaudited consolidated financial statements have been prepared assuming that the Company will continue as a going concern.
The Company is executing on a plan to achieve a reduction in operating losses.
Fountainhead, the Company’s largest shareholder, has provided working capital funding to the Company on an as-needed basis, although there is no guarantee that this will continue to be the case.

estimates.t: The Company’s unaudited consolidated financial statements are prepared in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles in the United States.
